COURT TRIAL ON APR-12-2004 OFF CALENDAR - JUDGMENT ENTERED. THOAMS BREEN, VISITING JUDGE; D.CARTER, CLERK; PATRICIA VAN STEENBURGH, CSR. 1742.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HO FO LP RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT DOYLE, JIM THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 1375 CALIFORNIA STREET #301 SAN FRANCISCO, CA., LEASE FORFEITED, PLUS COST PER COST BILL AND REASONABLE ATTORNEY FEES PER NOTICED MOTION. WRIT TO ISSUE FORTHWITH.
